summary: Frontend-only E2E (Playwright, desktop 1920 + one mobile 390 check) of the Sales follow-ups & reminders round, run on a dedicated TEST_UI lead (TEST_UI FollowUp 3286, created via API and assigned to sales_bk; cleaned up with manual_end -> inspections 3, leads 1, properties 1 deleted, follow-ups cascade-deleted, 0 left over). Every requested flow works: Follow-ups panel on every stage; scheduling two follow-ups (kind select, quick picks, note) lists them earliest first with '2 open' and the Next step banner showing the earliest one; Done dialog (outcome + next follow-up toggle pre-ticked) moves the item to Contact history, creates the next follow-up and changes status new->contacted; Reschedule (Next week) and Cancel ('Email cancelled' in history); Log contact (Text, next toggle unticked) shows in history; status select has only New/Contacted/Qualified/Won/Lost and Qualified persists after reload; Inspection Book -> 'Booked · date' items, 'Record inspection results' dialog (prefilled inspector/notes) turns a booking into a recorded inspection, Cancel shows 'Booking cancelled'; Leads view chips, counts, Assigned/Next action columns, ?view=unassigned from URL; Home cards for owner (incl. Unassigned) and sales_bk (follow-up due earlier today shows as '1 due today' with 8:00 AM, booked inspection listed, no Unassigned card); sales_bk sees no Mine/Unassigned chips, ?view=unassigned falls back to Open, and opening another rep's lead shows 'This lead is not assigned to you' (403). Found 2 minor issues, no blockers.

minor.issue: Cancelling does not set completed_at or completed_by (routers/follow_ups.py ~L112-117 handles only 'done' and 'open'). FollowUpsPanel puts history entries at completed_at || due_at, so a cancelled follow-up shows its future due date (e.g. 'Dec 2, 9:00 AM') instead of the time it was cancelled, sorts to the top of Contact history above real past contacts, and has no 'by' user.

integration_issues.issue: The link always goes to /leads?view=overdue. When the card only has items due today (0 overdue · 1 due today), View all opens an empty list (0 rows). It should open view=today when there are no overdue items, or a combined due view.

issues: The Reschedule and Cancel buttons show only an icon, with no tooltip or aria-label.
Cancel removes the follow-up at once, with no confirm and no undo (estimate and quote delete have undo).

action_items: Set completed_at = now and completed_by = user.email when a follow-up is cancelled, so history shows the time it was cancelled and who cancelled it.
Point the Follow-ups due 'View all' link to view=today when overdue_count is 0 (or add a combined due view).
Optional: add a title or aria-label to the reschedule and cancel icon buttons, and an undo toast for cancel.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadDetail.addInspection: recording results on a booked inspection overwrites inspection_date with now(). This is fine as the actual date, but the booked time is lost.
FollowUpDialog: in log/complete mode the next follow-up kind is always 'call' and cannot be changed.
Leads.jsx loads every lead (544 for owner) and filters on the client. This is OK for now but will need paging later.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 2 minor issues

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI lead ee46d1d8-15a4-4af0-8a55-f7729812ad01 with property 3286 TEST_UI Way, plus its follow-ups and inspections. All removed with manual_end. No existing leads were touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the manual_begin/manual_end helper in tests/_test_data_cleanup.py with an API-created TEST_UI lead assigned to sales_bk. Follow-ups are stored in the lead_follow_ups table (CASCADE on lead delete). Browser timezone is UTC. Proposals card flagging was not exercised in the UI (no quotes created); backend tests cover it.
